newsitem.title: USA: Rofin-Sinar stake held by British group.
newsitem.headline: Rofin-Sinar stake held by British group.

text.p: A group led by Henderson Plc, based in London, England, said Tuesday it holds a 10.02 percent stake in Rofin-Sinar Technologies Inc or 1,153,400 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 354,300 common shares between January 7 and February 18 at prices ranging from $11.375 to $14.5313 per share.
Rofin-Sinar makes laser products for cutting, welding and marking industrial materials such as steel plates and automobiles. Its principal executive offices are in Hamburg, Germany.
